title: Derivative of a Gaussian CDF composition
statement:
Let $\rho,a\in\mathbb R$ and $b\in(0,1)$. The function
\[
p\longmapsto \Phi\!\left(\frac{Q(p)-\rho Q(a)}{\sqrt{1-\rho^2}}\right)
\]
has derivative at $p=b$ equal to
\[
\frac{\varphi\!\left(\frac{Q(b)-\rho Q(a)}{\sqrt{1-\rho^2}}\right)}{\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,U(b)},
\]
where $\Phi$ is the standard Gaussian distribution function, $Q$ is its lower quantile, $\varphi$ is the standard Gaussian density, and $U(b)=\varphi(Q(b))$ is the Gaussian isoperimetric profile.
